title: TikTok: A penny cost 3.7 cents to make
_sources: US Mint FY2024 Annual Report via CoinNews 2025-02-10: penny unit cost 3.69 cents, one-cent seigniorage -$85.3M, 3.172B cents shipped, 19th consecutive year above face value, nickel 13.78 cents. AP/ABC 2025-11-12: final circulating pennies struck in Philadelphia, made since 1793.

lines.text: America spent almost four cents to make every single penny.
Metal, minting, shipping: three point six nine cents each.
In 2024 alone, the Mint shipped over three billion.
That's an eighty-five million dollar loss. On a one-cent coin.
And it lost money for nineteen years in a row.
So in November 2025, after two hundred thirty-two years, the U.S. stopped making them.
And the nickel? It costs almost fourteen cents to make a five-cent coin.
So next time you find a penny, remember:
